title.narrative: Program to Support the Recovery and Expansion of the Tourism Sector in El Salvador
Programa de Apoyo a la Recuperacin y Expansin del Sector Turismo en El Salvador

description.narrative: El objetivo general de la operacin es mejorar la competitividad internacional y nacional a nivel turstico de El Salvador. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) aumentar el gasto turstico internacional y domstico por visitante; (ii) incrementar el empleo turstico, en particular el empleo formal, y reducir las brechas de gnero a nivel sectorial; (iii) aumentar la inversin privada turstica; (iv) fortalecer la capacidad institucional sectorial; y (v) reforzar la sostenibilidad medioambiental de los destinos tursticos salvadoreos.

The general objective of the operation is to improve El Salvador's international and national tourism competitiveness. The specific objectives are: (i) increase international and domestic tourist spending per visitor; (ii) increase tourism employment, particularly formal employment, and reduce gender gaps at the sector level; (iii) increase private investment in tourism, (iv) strengthen the sector's institutional capacity, and (v) reinforce the environmental sustainability of Salvadoran tourist destinations.
